title: A root's placeholder names reach no production path: redact and the tracked-file leak scan never pass a root
goal: redact.py takes --root and the tracked-file leak scan (check.py, kbpublic.file_hits) passes each file's root to leak_hits, so a root's listed placeholder names are treated as placeholders in that root's files only, while the leak shapes stay the same for every root

run:
import subprocess, sys
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '_tools/redact.py', '--help'], capture_output=True, text=True)
assert '--root' in p.stdout, 'redact.py takes no --root, so no pipeline can pass a root'

notes: Review G1 of SP-iir3d2tu: redact.py:269/303/322 and kbcommon.leak_hits(root=) exist but no caller outside the tests passes a root; check.py:908 and kbpublic.py:559 pass none (gate g4 of ST-eimj36y3 chose that for the push scan; the clause 'for that root's files' stays unmet for redact).
